name: Judah I — Lion’s Rally
ability_text: When you become Champion of any track, gain +1 extra Glory.

name: Judah II — Wholehearted Charge
ability_text: Once per round, when investing in Military, your tokens count as +1.

name: Judah III — First in Line
ability_text: Once per game, after Influence is revealed, you may move 1 of your tokens to a different track.

name: Benjamin I — Left-Handed Strike
ability_text: When you become Military Champion, gain +1 Warrior.

name: Benjamin II — Hidden Dagger
ability_text: Once per round, you may treat 1 Warrior as 2 Influence on the Military Track.

name: Benjamin III — Deliverer’s Legacy
ability_text: After winning Military Champion, you may immediately take a free Recruit action. The action is free; you still pay its cost.

name: Levi I — Covenant Zeal
ability_text: When you become Moral Champion, raise Covenant Meter by 1.

name: Levi II — Intercession
ability_text: Once per round, spend 1 Faith to prevent 1 Covenant loss.

name: Levi III — Turned Away Wrath
ability_text: Once per game, one track you held counts twice, cancelling a failed track.

name: Ephraim I — Prophetic Voice
ability_text: Once per round, when investing in Moral Track, gain +1 Faith if you become Champion.

name: Ephraim II — Many Sons
ability_text: When you unlock this, add +1 Goods to your per-round income, permanently.

name: Ephraim III — Landed Authority
ability_text: Once per round, you may convert 2 Goods into 1 Faith or 1 Warrior. This costs no action — trade and still take your turn.

name: Manasseh I — Fleece Test
ability_text: Once per round, before placing Influence, look at one track’s current special modifier (if any).

name: Manasseh II — Thirty Towns
ability_text: Gain +1 Goods when the Provision Track reaches High.

name: Manasseh III — Outcast’s Resolve
ability_text: When a track you invested in fails, you lose 1 less Loyalty (minimum 0).

name: Reuben I — Firstborn Advance
ability_text: You always place last in the placement phase, seeing how heavily every other tribe has committed before you commit.

name: Reuben II — Pathfinder
ability_text: When you place at least 2 Influence on one track, name a second track you left empty and gain 1 temporary Supply Influence there.

name: Reuben III — Bold Claim
ability_text: Once per game, gain +1 Glory for a track where you were not Champion but stood second in Banner strength. It applies itself the first generation it can.

name: Simeon I — Vengeful Strike
ability_text: When you become Military Champion, gain +1 Warrior.

name: Simeon II — Furious Assault
ability_text: After a Military Track failure you invested in, 1 free token is placed on Military for you next round, on top of whatever else you plan. It counts as a Banner.

name: Simeon III — Raid Leader
ability_text: Once per round, convert 1 Goods into 1 Warrior or vice versa at no loss. This costs no action — trade and still take your turn.

name: Dan I — Nazirite Strength
ability_text: If all your Banners are on a single track, they count double.

name: Dan II — Riddle & Cunning
ability_text: Once per round, you may move 1 of your tokens after all others are revealed.

name: Dan III — Final Stand
ability_text: Once per game, spend 2 Warriors so one track you held counts twice.

name: Naphtali I — Doe’s Leap
ability_text: Once per round, after the reveal, you may move 1 of your placed tokens to another track.

name: Naphtali II — Swift Response
ability_text: When you become Champion, you owe 1 temporary Influence to another tribe — name them and the track at your next placement. It arrives as Supply.

name: Naphtali III — Northern Alliance
ability_text: Once per game, after the reveal, name two tracks; your Influence on each counts 1 more.

name: Gad I — Raider’s Resolve
ability_text: Reduce all Loyalty loss you suffer by 1 (minimum 0).

name: Gad II — Enduring Defense
ability_text: When Military Track is Low, your tokens on it count as +1.

name: Gad III — Overcomer
ability_text: Once per game, one track you held counts twice, cancelling a failed track.

name: Asher I — Blessed Abundance
ability_text: When Provision Track reaches High, gain +1 extra Goods.

name: Asher II — Fertile Blessing
ability_text: Once per round, when you take a Generate Goods action, gain 1 additional Goods.

name: Asher III — Rich Harvest
ability_text: Once per game, double the Goods you gain from any single action or Champion reward.

name: Issachar I — Understanding of Times
ability_text: Once per round, before placing tokens, look at one track’s current threshold status.

name: Issachar II — Strategic Insight
ability_text: When you become Champion of any track, gain +1 Faith.

name: Issachar III — Wise Counsel
ability_text: Once per game, after all tokens are placed, you may force one other player to move 1 of their tokens.

name: Zebulun I — Sea Trader
ability_text: Once per round, convert 1 Faith ↔ 1 Goods at 1:1. This costs no action — trade and still take your turn.

name: Zebulun II — Commerce Route
ability_text: When you become Provision Champion, gain +1 Glory.

name: Zebulun III — Profitable Venture
ability_text: Once per game, after gaining Goods from any source, gain that many again.
